verified.exploit_entry_point: The repository's public write surface after PlainInit / git.Init: storing a reference through the storage interface, on both write implementations.
routes: T1: store 'config', 'refs/../../config' and 'hooks/pre-commit', on the common backend and on the simpler second implementation
verified.project_tests_run: go test ./storage/filesystem/dotgit ./storage/filesystem ./plumbing -count=1 (pinned, oracle, alternative, hardening and every check patch; Go 1.26.4)

traps.shape: a stored reference name resolves onto unrelated repository metadata or climbs out of the reference tree; coupled: nested refs and root pseudo-references keep storing and reading
traps.reason_to_dismiss: the write looks like the application's own repository data, and checking only for parent-path components looks sufficient until a name such as 'config' aliases metadata with no traversal at all
traps.realistic_because: published fix site; this is the advisory's own route

traps.shape: the second write implementation selected for filesystems without read-write capability performs the same name-to-path join with no check
traps.reason_to_dismiss: it exists only for simple filesystems that cannot open files read-write and is documented as single-process

traps.shape: the containment rule must not become a refs/-prefix or existing-validator rule: the layer accepts single-component names, root pseudo-references, the partial-clone placeholder and symbolic targets, and reflogs under logs/HEAD
traps.reason_to_dismiss: the neighbouring placeholder-looking names invite a rule that refuses them
traps.realistic_because: each value is a legitimate use exercised by the pinned project's own storage suite

wrong_fix_catalogue.crash_as_refusal: n/a: every refusal returns an error; a crash would abort the Go test binary instead of reading as a clean refusal
wrong_fix_catalogue.wrong_resource: n/a: the control has one object class (the reference name) and no proxy object
wrong_fix_catalogue.one_role_or_direction: n/a: there are no roles, peers or directions; every caller uses the same storage interface
wrong_fix_catalogue.reads_only: n/a: the control's only protected operation is the write
wrong_fix_catalogue.check_after_adjustment: n/a: the control's route has no adjustment before the path join
wrong_fix_catalogue.unlisted_route: n/a: the control intentionally covers only the advisory's own write route
wrong_fix_catalogue.malformed_identity: n/a: no identity or credential is parsed; the guarded value is a reference name
wrong_fix_catalogue.missing_authority: n/a: there is no authority lookup whose empty answer could fail open
